caption: In a bathroom with wood-grain tiled walls, several white-framed openings, and wall-mounted dispensers, a man in a white lab coat is seen from behind in the foreground and reflected in the mirror. He holds an upright pink-and-yellow plush dog in one hand and a vertical orange ruler in the other, with the ruler held beside the toy. The foreground hands and the mirror image are the same objects, not separate people. The plush and ruler remain nearly fixed relative to each other and the background, with only slight hand jitter. The reflected man's mouth repeatedly opens and closes in a speech-like motion, while his head tilts gradually backward and his gaze shifts upward. The camera appears stationary, so the tiles, frames, and dispensers show no noticeable shift, and the ruler shows no clear sliding along the toy. The action remains ongoing rather than completed.
